subject: Redwood x OpenWeights — distribution agreement draft
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma@openweights.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: OpenWeights Legal <contracts@openweights.org>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Distribution collaboration: Redwood x OpenWeights - initial terms

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking the intro yesterday. OpenWeights Collective (OWC) is excited about a potential distribution partnership with Redwood. High-level ask: we want a commercial channel so customers can access hosted inference (API) and a marketplace listing for model variants while protecting the integrity of our full-precision checkpoints.

High-level starter terms we wanted to float:
- Non-exclusive distribution (OWC retains IP)
- Publisher revenue share: OWC 60% of net revenue from hosted inference
- No rehosting of full-precision weights; permitted: quantized/compiled variants for inference
- 30-day embargo on public release of source checkpoints after initial launch to coordinate communications

Can we schedule a short call next week to run through the specifics (licensing, attribution, and any marketplace take rates)? I attached a short LOI that outlines the items above.

Attachment: OWC-Redwood-LOI-v1.pdf (PDF, 312KB)

Best,
Emma Zhao
Head of Partnerships | OpenWeights Collective\emma@openweights.org
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Distribution collaboration: Redwood x OpenWeights - initial terms

Emma — thanks for the LOI and the clear asks. We'd love to explore this. Quick responses to the bullets so we come prepared: 

- Non-exclusive: fine.
- Revenue share: can you clarify whether 60% is pre- or post-marketplace/take rate? We typically structure as publisher % of net after a platform fee; example: publisher gets 65% net after a 10% platform fee, or we can discuss a blended schedule for hosted vs dedicated deployments.
- Rehosting: we need clarity on "full-precision" language — for Dedicated/private we can offer controlled distribution under enterprise contracts; for the hosted API we generally serve quantized/optimized runtime variants and can restrict access to weights.
- Embargo: 30 days is reasonable as a starting point; need to confirm legal on export/third-party dataset considerations.

Can we get legal and commercial on the same call? Looping in Laura (partnerships) and Sergio (channels) to pick a time. Proposed slots: Mon 6/15 10am PT or Tue 6/16 2pm PT.

Thanks — attaching a lightweight counter with our standard distribution points so we can iterate.

Attachment: RW-proposed-distribution-terms-v2.pdf (PDF, 206KB)

—Priyom
Priyom Das

From: OpenWeights Legal <contracts@openweights.org>

Cc: Emma Zhao <emma@openweights.org>, Michael Tan <michael.tan@indconsult.io>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Distribution collaboration: Redwood x OpenWeights - initial terms

Hi Priyom — following up from Emma's note with a short legal summary so we have alignment before the call. Key points from OWC perspective: 

1) Commercial rights: OWC grants Redwood a right to distribute inference endpoints and quantized derivatives for customer-facing hosted products. No right to redistribute or publish the original full-precision checkpoint.

2) Revenue: OWC expects 60% of net revenue (after payment-processing fees and direct infra pass-throughs).

3) Attribution & licensing: All downstream use must carry OWC attribution. Models trained on datasets with third-party restrictions will require compliance checks — we will provide a licensing summary.

4) Embargo: 30-day embargo on public checkpoint release post-launch; internal sharing under NDA is allowed.

Attachment: OWC-licensing-summary.docx (DOCX, 48KB)

We can be flexible on the revenue timing (monthly payout, 45-day net). We're open to carve-outs for Dedicated/private where enterprise customers sign a separate license.

Regards,
OpenWeights Legal (on behalf of OWC)
contracts@openweights.org

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: OpenWeights Legal <contracts@openweights.org>
Cc: Emma Zhao <emma@openweights.org>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Distribution collaboration: Redwood x OpenWeights - initial terms

Thanks for the clear legal summary. A few counterpoints from Redwood's side to help our legal and commercial teams draft redlines: 

- Revenue split: Redwood proposes a 65% publisher share of net revenue (post platform fee). We can tier that up to 70% with minimum guarantee or for models that opt into revenue-sharing promotional programs.
- Net definition: We agree on excluding payment processing fees and direct infra pass-throughs; we propose clarifying "direct infra" and excluding shared platform costs (we can provide a sample calculation).
- Rehosting: For Hosted API we will only surface quantized/runtime variants. For Dedicated/private we can support distribution of checkpoints under a separate enterprise license; this should be opt-in per model.
- Embargo: Redwood prefers a 14-day embargo for public checkpoint release with an option for up to 30 days on a case-by-case basis if there are joint marketing plans. 

Next steps: can Laura and Sergio coordinate with your team to produce a single redline? We'll push legal to review the attached RW-proposed-distribution-terms-v2 and then iterate.

Thanks,
—Priyom
Attachment: RW-proposed-distribution-terms-v2.pdf (PDF, 206KB)
